arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Process Hollowing by APT41 ShadowPad
id: a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab
status: test
description: Detects process hollowing activity associated with APT41 ShadowPad, including creation of known mutex and outbound connections to known C2 domains.
author: SOC Team
date: 2026-09-30
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 10
    ImageLoaded|contains: ['\dll']
  hollowing:
    TargetImage|contains: ['\svchost.exe', '\explorer.exe']
    CallTrace|contains: ['NtAllocateVirtualMemory', 'NtWriteVirtualMemory', 'NtResumeThread']
  mutex:
    MutexName|contains: 'Global\\APT41_ShadowPad_'
  network:
    DestinationHostname|endswith: '.ezdns.cc'
    DestinationPort|gte: 80
  condition: selection and hollowing and (mutex or network)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate software performing code injection for debugging
level: high
